name: Dea ex Machina
source:
You are useless without your magic, and you don't know why it's gone. In desperation, you go into an abandoned temple to pray to a statue of your goddess in hopes of getting your magic back. She's totally going to help you in your hour of need... right? 

[From [url=https://knickknackpj.itch.io/dem]itch.io[/url]]
